title: Liria 09 – A Conversation with Aeon
summary: The citadel rested quietly beneath the night sky, bright with stars.
story:
The citadel rested quietly beneath the night sky, bright with stars.

In a private study, Aeon was examining several reports when the door opened.

"Working again?"

Liria entered and placed two steaming cups on the table.

Aeon looked up.

"The development of the eastern districts requires our attention."

"I thought it might."

Liria sat opposite him.

"I was there today."

Aeon set the documents aside.

"And?"

"People are pleased with the new buildings. But many miss the old gathering places."

Aeon studied the city map.

"The expansion improves services and provides additional housing."

"That's true," Liria replied. "But to the residents, the old square was more than an open space."

She took a sip from her cup.

"Children played there. Merchants met there. Families celebrated together."

Aeon fell thoughtfully silent.

"You believe we've overlooked something."

"I believe there's something we never asked."

Liria slid her notes toward him.

"What makes a place truly feel like home to the people who live there?"

Aeon read through some of the reports.

After a while, he picked up a pen and amended the existing plans.

"Then the new districts should have gathering spaces of their own."

Liria smiled.

"That sounds much better."

Aeon regarded her.

"You have a remarkable gift for noticing even the smallest changes."

"And you can see the long-term consequences among a thousand possibilities."

She raised her cup.

"That's why we work so well together."

Aeon returned the gesture with a rare smile.

Outside, Novaris lay peacefully beneath the stars.

Two of its founders had just made a decision that could improve many lives.

Not through power.

But through mutual understanding.

A good future took shape where foresight and compassion met.
